t: This Essentials flexible tap connector is designed for reliable water supply connections in various plumbing applications. Featuring a 13mm bore, it ensures efficient water flow for taps in both domestic and commercial settings. The connector is suitable for drinking water, making it a safe choice for kitchen and bathroom installations. Constructed with an EPDM rubber inner tube and a robust stainless steel braided hose, it offers durability and resistance to corrosion, providing a long-lasting solution for trade professionals requiring dependable plumbing components.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
Certified Safe & Suitable for Drinking Water Applications
Durable EPDM Rubber Inner Tube Offers Flexibility
Stainless Steel Braided Hose for Strength & Durability
Standard 22mm x 3/4" x 500mm Size for Easy Fit
Flexible Design Simplifies Tap Installation & Replacement
